name: Paragon Finance Limited
summary: Paragon Fine & Speciality Chemical Ltd. engages in the business of custom synthesis and manufacturing of speciality chemical intermediates involving complex and differentiated chemistry. The company was founded by Pravinchandra Jasmat Vasolia, Kishorkumar Panchabhai Patolia, Vallabh Ratanji Savaliya on February 2, 2003, and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
